latest.title: Asymptotic dimension of 3-dimensional CAT(0) manifolds
latest.abstract: We prove that every $3$-manifold equipped with a proper metric admitting a convex geodesic bicombing has Assouad--Nagata dimension at most $3$. In particular, every proper CAT$(0)$ $3$-manifold has Assouad--Nagata dimension at most $3$. As a corollary one obtains that the isoperimetric gap theorem of Lang-Stadler-Urech (\cite{LSU}) and Peteranderl\cite{Pet}, generalizes from 3-dimensional Hadamard manifolds to 3-dimensional CAT(0) manifolds.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 证明带 proper 度量且存在凸测地双梳的三维流形，其 Assouad–Nagata 维数至多为三；特别覆盖 proper CAT(0) 三流形。
latest.breakthrough: 去掉光滑 Hadamard 假设；与既有填充定理结合，为渐近秩至多二的 CAT(0) 三流形得到线性高维填充不等式。
latest.limitations: 核心使用三维流形和球面的分离性质，不是所有三维 CAT(0) 复形或任意维数的结论；线性填充还需要渐近秩条件。
latest.priorityReason: 非光滑粗几何的重要扩展，证明的球面—环带覆盖机制具有复用价值；已核对主定理与证明纲要。
